prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 20:9 overscan master candidate for a game GUI facility background in the Element Maze JRPG static prototype. Primary request: Create an Earth-region provisions shop / travel shop background in Japanese visual novel fantasy CG style, anime-style JRPG facility art, for later cropping to a 1672x941 GUI background. Scene/backdrop: A hot and humid Earth-region forest-quarry market shop built into carved leyline stone and dark timber. Interior has breathable shade screens, woven baskets, clay jars, herbs, mossy stone shelves, travel packs, ropes, mineral samples, root-fiber cloth bundles, mushrooms in trays, geodes, preserved fruits, and warm amber resin lamps mixed with muted green-gold leyline glow. Keep readable left and middle background depth for GUI panels, not a flat wall and not an outdoor-only forest scene. Subject: Rabi, adult female elf-like shopkeeper, visual-only candidate NPC. Soft Japanese VN / JRPG face, pointed ears visible, neck-length short hair / short bob ending around the neck, warm chestnut or olive-brown hair, lively practical merchant expression, slim but grounded adult build. She wears conservative hot-climate shopkeeper clothing: cream linen blouse with short or cap sleeves, moss-green cropped vest, light brown waist apron, bead-and-stone bracelet, small belt pouch, no heavy coat, no winter layers. She is medium-close half-body in the right foreground, one hand near a basket of supplies or a small ledger with no readable writing, face in the upper-right safe zone with breathing room from the image edge, hands and counter visible. Style/medium: polished 2D anime fantasy game background, Japanese visual novel facility CG, clean elegant linework, painterly mature JRPG texture, soft facial features, detailed but not cluttered. Composition/framing: extra-wide 20:9 landscape overscan. Design the central 80% so it can crop cleanly to 16:9. Keep Rabi medium-close on the right or center-right, face around x 68%-82% and y 14%-34% of the eventual 16:9 crop, not cropped. Preserve usable left/middle space for GUI list and detail panels. Lower counter and hands may be partly hidden by GUI panels; face and core torso must remain safe. Lighting/mood: warm humid forest-shop atmosphere, amber resin lamps, green-gold leyline glow, cool filtered forest window light, rich dark wood and mossy stone. Color palette: moss green, olive, dark timber brown, warm amber, muted gold-green, clay terracotta, cream linen. Materials/textures: carved quarry stone, moss, roots, woven baskets, linen, clay, brass clips, geodes, herbs, dried fungi, root fiber, dark timber. Constraints: no in-image text, no readable signs, no UI panels, no logos, no runtime IDs, no watermark, no captions.
